description: Per-substrate, per-enzyme UGT hepatocyte-basis in-vitro->in-vivo scaling factors (B-14). Default 1.0 = no-op. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-30-hepatic-ugt-ivive-differential-design.md. PHASE 0 OUTCOME (2026-05-30): all SFs = 1.0 (no-op). The decisive blind verification found NO verified per-substrate hepatocyte-basis hepatic-fraction UGT IVIVE-SF: the morphine '16x' is HLM/microsomal basis (wrong basis for this hepatocyte-trained ML), morphine glucuronidation is substantially renal (excluded from B-14), and the only hepatocyte-basis number is a non-disaggregable 13-drug class geomean (~2.7x, AAPS J 2020). Per the spec's single-point/anti-confabulation rule, unverifiable-per-substrate => 1.0. See DE-40. NOTE: this SF acts at EVERY node carrying the enzyme (today liver + gut UGT2B7); a future kidney-UGT node REQUIRES basis re-derivation to avoid double-counting the renal fraction.

substrates.note: Under-prediction is documented but not as a verified hepatocyte-basis HEPATIC-fraction number. The famous up-to-16x is HLM+albumin (microsomal, wrong basis for a hepatocyte-trained engine). Glucuronidation is substantially RENAL (renal CLint,UGT ~1/3 of hepatic per-gram for UGT2B7) and renal is out of B-14 scope. Hepatocyte-basis under-prediction exists only as a 13-drug class geomean (~2.7x), not disaggregable to morphine within budget. SF=1.0.

literature.citation: Gill KL, Houston JB, Galetin A. Characterization of in vitro glucuronidation clearance in human kidney microsomes: comparison with liver and intestine, impact of albumin. Drug Metab Dispos. 2012;40(4):825-835.
literature.reported_value: HLM+albumin up to ~16x CLint increase; renal CLint,UGT ~1/3 of hepatic per-gram for UGT2B7 substrates

literature.citation: Knights KM, Spencer SM, Fallon JK, et al. Scaling factors for the IVIVE of renal drug and xenobiotic glucuronidation clearance. Br J Clin Pharmacol. 2016;81(6):1153-1164.

substrates.note: Same as morphine: no verified per-substrate hepatocyte-basis hepatic-fraction SF; HLM-basis and renal contaminate the accessible numbers; hepatocyte class geomean ~2.7x not disaggregable. SF=1.0.

literature.reported_value: covered by the UGT-substrate class geomean AFE 0.37
